name: THE WINDCALLER
window: callerOpen(e) (main.js:12840) takes normal dmg in 'twister','lightning','cast','howlTell','howl','ground','fallen'; hurtEnemy0 fully blocks damage (return) outside that list (main.js:5395). No bonus multiplier for a specific sub-state, but reflecting his bolt into him (parry -> returnBolt -> knockCaller) forces 'fallen' plus a flat extra hit (main.js:12844-12845, 19061).
a11why: he is open at normal dmg by default whenever not mid wall/stone/teleport, which recurs on his own attack timer (waited, main.js:12840,5395); parrying his own bolt back into him is a genuine caused opening that knocks him down for extra damage (caused, main.js:7391,12845,19061)
a10: At <50% hp (main.js:12788) his cooldowns shorten and he gains a phase-only hail-curtain 'wall' attack with one gap to stand in (main.js:12810,12821-12828).

name: THE QUEEN'S LANCE
window: lanceOpen(e) (main.js:16537) = planted/thrust/sweep/guardSwing/reel/stumble/recover/javThrow take normal dmg, 1.6x while 'planted'; outside that his plate blocks the hit entirely (return) (main.js:5425).
a11why: a dash attack landed on his guard (not already open, not braced) knocks him OFF BALANCE into 'reel' for a caused opening (main.js:5419-5424); dodging/luring his charge into the arena edge drives him into 'planted', his best 1.6x window (main.js:16463-16464); ordinary whiff/parry openings (recover/stumble/reel) also recur each attack cycle (waited, smaller factor)
a10: At hp<=50% (main.js:5533) he throws away the lance for shield-only combat: charge/thrust/vault/javelin/gale are replaced by a whirlwind spin, a shield rush and a guard-sweep (main.js:16500-16523).

name: THE GOBLIN QUEEN
window: gqOpen(e) (main.js:15090) recognizes only mode==='pinned', but the actual damage gate in hurtEnemy0 opens full dmg on BOTH 'pinned' and 'dazed' (main.js:5401); outside those her plate blocks the hit entirely (return).
a11why: breaking a support/pillar drops it on her (gallery collapse) to force 'pinned' -- a caused window with chip damage (main.js:15119); dropping her own chandelier on her likewise forces 'dazed' (caused, main.js:17587); but 'dazed' also happens automatically after every charge attack ends at an edge or times out, with no player action required (waited, main.js:15238)
a10: Phase 2 (<=66% hp) opens the hall's windows so a storm gust periodically shoves the player (main.js:15155,15158); phase 3 (<=33% hp) adds a shadow-teleport-behind-you sweep (main.js:15156,15197); below 15% hp (phase>1) she enrages, attacking faster (main.js:15143).
bugs: The 'two states, two colours, and never both' comment (main.js:22272-22274) is false in code: gqOpen() only recognizes 'pinned' (main.js:15090), but hurtEnemy0's real damage gate also opens on 'dazed' (main.js:5401). While she's dazed (e.g. after every charge that hits a wall), she is fully damageable but the game still renders the purple WARDED shell instead of the green open ring, misinforming the player she's still armored.

name: THE FORGEMASTER
window: forgeOpen(e) = 'stun' or 'scald' -> dmg*2; outside that his iron armor still takes dmg*0.5 -- he is never fully immune (main.js:5426,14915).
a11why: riding or kicking an ore cart into him stuns him (caused, main.js:12949); bursting his boiler with a cart or an ember scalds him (caused, main.js:19830); his own dropped hammer prop stuns him if he's caught under it (caused, main.js:19833); outside those he can still be chipped at half damage at any time (always/baseline)
a10: At hp<=50% 'THE FURNACE OPENS' (main.js:14761): he gains a fire-breath attack and spawns bats that harass the player.

name: THE WINCHMASTER
window: winchOpen(e) = mode==='downed' -> 2x dmg (winchmaster.js:75-76,163); otherwise he takes normal dmg at any time -- no immune state.
a11why: riding a loaded bucket (boarded at least WINCH.rideIn px out) into his own drum jams it and throws him 'downed' for the doubled-damage window -- explicitly documented and coded as the intended opening (winchmaster.js:18-21,109-117,163)
a10: At hp<=50% 'HE DRIVES THE DRUMS HARDER' (winchmaster.js:131-132): every line runs 25% faster, SEND drops two buckets instead of one, and the roof drops rocks twice as often (winchmaster.js:67,70,136,176).

name: THE TIDE HERALD
a2: 'raise' -- the wind-up for his biggest attack (the tidal wave) -- is a told mode (modeT=1.0s) but is NOT covered by windingUp(): the herald clause only lists sweepTell/thrustTell/spearTell/maelTell, and 'raise' doesn't end in 'Tell' so the generic catch-all misses it too (main.js:18448).
window: outside 'mired' (1.5x) and 'reel' (normal dmg, no reduction), he only takes 0.35x armored damage; never fully immune (main.js:5397).
a11why: 'mired' (his best 1.5x window) always follows his own raise -> wave -> ebb sequence on a fixed timer, regardless of anything the player does (waited, main.js:12227-12231); 'reel' (normal, unreduced dmg) is caused by blocking his thrustTell (caused, main.js:12224)
a10: Phase 2 (<=66% hp) floods the square deeper and lets him call tideguards and use the maelstrom pull (main.js:12155,12166,12169); phase 3 (<=33% hp) adds a glide-dash-into-sweep and a glaive throw that leaves him disarmed until he fetches it back (main.js:12156,12164,12167).
bugs: none observed beyond the A2 gap above

name: THE REEFMAW
window: fully blocked (return) while 'sleep'/'lurk'/'sink'; surfaced but not stuck/reeling it takes 0.5-0.7x; 'stuck' or 'reel' takes 2x (main.js:5364-5367).
a11why: dodging its bite so it lands on coral instead of the player jams its jaw 'stuck' for the 2x window (caused, main.js:12049-12051), with a further 20% chance to chain into 'reel' (also 2x, main.js:5367); it can also be chipped at reduced damage any time it's surfaced (always/baseline)
a10: Phase 2 (<=66% hp) floods its hole higher and adds the thrash sweep; phase 3 (<=33% hp) it comes fully out of its hole ('IT COMES RIGHT OUT', main.js:12028) and its tells speed up.

name: THE QUARTERMASTER
window: e.guard is a hard block -- full immunity, return -- entered after her deck-jump 'cut' attack; 'cut' and 'reel' otherwise take 1.5x normal dmg (main.js:5362-5363,11986).
a11why: shooting her (a gun/bomb) while guarded breaks the guard outright for 70 direct dmg and staggers her to 'reel' -- matching the in-fight hint 'BRING A GUN TO BEAR' (caused, main.js:7741,11986); parrying her slashTell also drops her into 'reel' for the 1.5x window (caused, main.js:11958)
a10: At each phase break (<=66%, <=33% hp) she leaps up a deck and cuts the way up behind her, raising her guard for 16s (main.js:11942-11943,11985-11987); on the last deck (phase 3) the main deck itself starts collapsing plank by plank (main.js:11987,12003-12011).

name: THE CAPTAIN
window: fully immune while 'ride' (untouchable on the wave he called); 'beach' (after riding) takes 2x; 'reel' takes 1.5x; otherwise normal dmg (main.js: hurtEnemy0 captain block).
a11why: he is only untouchable while riding a wave he called himself, and automatically beaches into the 2x window once that wave/wash timer ends -- both transitions run on his own rotation, with no player action required to cause either (main.js:9444-9449,9487-9489); baseline full damage is otherwise always available outside 'ride'
a10: Phase 2 (hp<62%) 'ALL HANDS AND A KEG' adds a bomb-keg throw and quickens the tide cycle (main.js:9444); phase 3 (hp<32%) 'HE WILL GO DOWN WITH HER' quickens it further and throws a second barrel (main.js:9445,9484).

name: THE TOLLMASTER
window: e.open>0 -> 2x dmg; carried (!onFoot) -> 0.7x; otherwise normal dmg -- never fully immune (main.js:9228, hurtEnemy0 tollmaster block).
a11why: parrying his ledger swing directly opens him for the 2x window (caused, main.js:9257); but every 'dark' lamp-snuffing attack also ends automatically with 'HIS HANDS ARE UP: CUT HIM' -- e.open is set on a fixed cooldown regardless of player action (waited, main.js:9273-9274,9288)
a10: At hp<62% he sets the bier down, four bearer guards join the fight, and this is the one time he's slow on his own feet (main.js:9231,9278-9286); at hp<30% he blacks out the room and snuffs 3 lamps at once instead of 1 (main.js:9233-9234,9312).

name: THE LAMPREEVE
a2: 'draw' (part of the black-water-breath wind-up, tracked separately from 'drawTell') is listed among his tells but is not recognized by windingUp(): the lampreeve clause only lists sweepTell/snuffTell/drawTell/hookTell, and 'draw' has no 'Tell' suffix for the catch-all to match (main.js:18448).
window: e.open>0 -> 2x dmg; otherwise normal dmg at any time -- never a hard immune state (main.js:9319, hurtEnemy0 lampreeve block).
a11why: he autonomously walks to whichever burning lamp is nearest himself and hoods it -- no player action required; the 'reach' state (e.open, the 2x window) follows automatically every time he finishes snuffing a lamp, on his own roughly 7-9.5s cooldown (main.js:9334-9354)
a10: no phases -- his one hp-based state change is entering phase 2 once only one lamp is left burning, which just quickens his movement/attack timers, not a new mechanic (main.js:9325-9327).
bugs: none observed beyond the A2 gap above
